name: array_value
description: Creates an `ARRAY` containing the argument values.

name: array_cross_product
description: Computes the cross product of two arrays of size 3. The array elements can not be `NULL`.

name: array_cosine_similarity
description: Computes the cosine similarity between two arrays of the same size. The array elements can not be `NULL`. The arrays can have any size as long as the size is the same for both arguments.

name: array_cosine_distance
description: Computes the cosine distance between two arrays of the same size. The array elements can not be `NULL`. The arrays can have any size as long as the size is the same for both arguments.

name: array_distance
description: Computes the distance between two arrays of the same size. The array elements can not be `NULL`. The arrays can have any size as long as the size is the same for both arguments.

name: array_inner_product
description: Computes the inner product between two arrays of the same size. The array elements can not be `NULL`. The arrays can have any size as long as the size is the same for both arguments.

name: array_negative_inner_product
description: Computes the negative inner product between two arrays of the same size. The array elements can not be `NULL`. The arrays can have any size as long as the size is the same for both arguments.

name: l2_distance
description: Computes the Euclidean distance between two vectors of the same size, given as lists or arrays of `FLOAT` or `DOUBLE`. The elements can not be `NULL`.

name: l2_sqr_distance
description: Computes the squared Euclidean distance between two vectors of the same size, given as lists or arrays of `FLOAT` or `DOUBLE`. The elements can not be `NULL`.

name: l1_distance
description: Computes the Manhattan distance between two vectors of the same size, given as lists or arrays of `FLOAT` or `DOUBLE`. The elements can not be `NULL`.

name: cosine_distance
description: Computes the cosine distance between two vectors of the same size, given as lists or arrays of `FLOAT` or `DOUBLE`. The elements can not be `NULL`; a zero vector is at distance 1 from every vector.

name: cosine_similarity
description: Computes the cosine similarity between two vectors of the same size, given as lists or arrays of `FLOAT` or `DOUBLE`. The elements can not be `NULL`; a zero vector has similarity 0 with every vector.

name: inner_product
description: Computes the inner product between two vectors of the same size, given as lists or arrays of `FLOAT` or `DOUBLE`. The elements can not be `NULL`.

name: negative_inner_product
description: Computes the negative inner product between two vectors of the same size, given as lists or arrays of `FLOAT` or `DOUBLE`. The elements can not be `NULL`.

name: l1_norm
description: Computes the Manhattan norm of a vector given as a list or array of `FLOAT` or `DOUBLE`. The elements can not be `NULL`.

name: l2_norm
description: Computes the Euclidean norm of a vector given as a list or array of `FLOAT` or `DOUBLE`. The elements can not be `NULL`.

name: l1_normalize
description: Divides a vector, given as a list or array of `FLOAT` or `DOUBLE`, by its Manhattan norm. A zero vector stays zero. The elements can not be `NULL`.

name: l2_normalize
description: Divides a vector, given as a list or array of `FLOAT` or `DOUBLE`, by its Euclidean norm. A zero vector stays zero. The elements can not be `NULL`.
